newsitem.title: USA: Magellan upped stocks to 93.5 pct in Jan -Fidelity.
newsitem.headline: Magellan upped stocks to 93.5 pct in Jan -Fidelity.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said its giant Magellan mutual fund increased the equities portion of its portfolio to 93.5 percent at January 31 from 89.6 percent at December 31.
Fidelity disclosed in the March issue of its monthly stock guide that bonds fell to 0.8 percent from 3.8 percent, while cash declined to 5.7 percent from 6.6 percent.
Fidelity said Magellan hiked the percentage of holdings in the technology sector to 14.6 percent from 13.7 percent. It also boosted the healthcare sector to 6.3 percent from 4.9 percent.
